02 / PRODUCTS

Focused tools. Practical applications.

TEAM AI WORKFLOWS

OPSCALE

Connect your team’s knowledge, tools, and execution permissions. Share skills across AI agents, automate recurring work, and manage versions and execution history in one place.

Explore the product ↗

AI VISUAL INSPECTION

NUVION

AI inspection for manufacturing sites with limited defect data. Combines zero-shot anomaly detection with NPU inference to reduce per-product retraining and support inspection on local hardware.

Explore the product ↗

NUVION is evaluated against each production line’s inspection data, lighting, and acceptance criteria. Applicable conditions and performance are validated on site.
